# Repository Overview

This repository contains the QA-Testing and database verification toolkit for the web application project.

## Repository Contents
* A. This Readme file, containing the test case for an AI-generated web application;[cite: 14]
* B. The AI prompt used to create the test web application named "webapp-generation-prompt.txt"; and[cite: 14]
* C. The single-file PHP web application generated by AI.[cite: 14]
